Jennifer provides LiHua with several suggestions to help improve his endurance. Firstly, she recommends incorporating longer cardio sessions into his workout routine. This could involve engaging in different cardiovascular activities such as cycling, running, or swimming to challenge the body in various ways and enhance endurance.

Secondly, Jennifer emphasizes the importance of interval training, which alternates periods of high-intensity effort with recovery or low-intensity periods. Interval training is known to be highly effective in increasing cardiovascular capacity and stamina over time.

Additionally, Jennifer advises LiHua to diversify his workouts, preventing the body from adapting too easily to repetitive strains, thus promoting continuous improvement in endurance. Mixing up activities can create a more comprehensive workout strategy that targets endurance from multiple angles.

Finally, Jennifer mentions the often overlooked aspects of endurance training, such as proper hydration and nutrition. Staying well-hydrated and consuming a balanced diet rich in nutrients can significantly support endurance performance and overall health.

In summary, Jennifer suggests a blend of extended cardio sessions, interval training, activity variety, and attention to hydration and nutrition as key strategies to help LiHua boost his endurance. She also looks forward to discussing these topics further in their next session, showing her commitment to providing personalized guidance and support.
